PhD Funding Programs
PhD Funding Programs of the Graduate Academy / TUD
© Background: www.freepik.com / Graphic: GA
The Graduate Academy / TUD offers various funding programs to support the different phases of the PhD.
Long-term Funding
Saxon Scholarship Program
The Free State of Saxony provides funding for the promotion of PhD students for up to three years. The grant amounts to EUR 1,500 per month plus family allowance of EUR 100 for each dependent child (if applicable).
Eligibility: (Prospective) Doctoral candidates
Application deadline: currently not known
Maria Reiche Doctoral Fellowships (without Faculty of Medicine)
Within the Maria Reiche Doctoral Fellowships (without Faculty of Medicine), grants up to three years can be awarded for women working on their doctoral degree. The monthly rate amounts to EUR 1,500. In addition, a monthly family allowance of EUR 400 for the first child and EUR 100 for each further child will be awarded.
Eligibility: (Prospective) Female doctoral candidates
Application deadline: currently not known
Short-term Funding
Grants for the Completion and Wrap-up Phase
These grants support doctoral candidates for up to three months during the completion and wrap-up phase of their doctorate. The bridging period enables researchers to finish their PhD, but also to publish their results and to prepare an application for a postdoctoral position. The monthly grant for PhD students amounts to EUR 1,500 and for postdoc students to EUR 1,750 plus a non-personnel cost subsidy as well as a family allowance, if the latter is applicable.
Eligibility: Doctoral candidates in the final phase of their doctorate
Proofreading Service
This grant aims to support the visibility of the research achievements of doctoral candidates and postdocs. For this purpose, the Graduate Academy of TUD grants allowances for proofreading services (German or English) for foreign-language publications of doctoral candidates of TUD.
Eligibility: Doctoral candidates & postdocs
Detailed information and all application documents can be found under Proofreading Service.
Please note our GA funding programs for mobility and network grants!
